name: How long will I be without a usable shower during installation?

mainEntity.name: How long will I be without a usable shower during installation?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A straightforward tub conversion may take less time than a full bathroom remodel, but no dependable schedule can be set until the layout, materials, permits, and wall conditions are reviewed. Elite Remodeling & Design can establish a project sequence after design development and selections.

Demolition may reveal damaged framing, old plumbing, or subfloor problems that require correction before waterproofing and finishes.

Key factors:
- Custom versus readily available materials
- Glass fabrication and tile availability
- Plumbing or electrical changes
- Inspection timing and unforeseen repairs

Ask for milestone dates rather than only one completion date: demolition, rough work, waterproofing, tile, glass, and final inspection. Confirm which decisions must be made before work starts.

Early selections and a complete scope generally provide better schedule clarity.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration depends on demolition, plumbing, waterproofing, tile, glass, inspections, material availability, and hidden conditions. Ask for milestone dates and identify whether the plan includes a backup for unexpected repairs. Final timing should be confirmed after the existing bathroom is assessed.
